theme: shipping a pocket-size map that answers like the atlas
title: Pocket Atlas: Spectrum-Preserving Sparsifier Duel
strategies: naive heaviest-edge baseline: keep the s heaviest original edges unchanged (ignores the published test-vector family entirely)

textbook effective-resistance / leverage-score sampling: rank edges by w_e * R_e over the full pseudoinverse of L_G and keep the top-s (spectrally sound for all of R^n, but blind to which directions are actually probed)

leverage-score inversion restricted to the published K-vector family's own span, plus a bounded linear program that redistributes weight across the selected support to minimize the worst relative error over all K targets simultaneously
iterative local search / coordinate refinement over edge subsets seeded from the restricted-relevance ranking, trading off which cluster's targets get priority under the shared quota
